item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over Guangdong tomorrow, there will be thunderstorms over inland areas. Winds will be weak and the weather will be hot over the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week.
